isolation: No shared mutable state exists to isolate: the hello-api has a single stateless GET /greeting endpoint with no per-caller data. Each scenario is independent because it only asserts on the HTTP response to its own request(s), driven below the UI via curl with a freshly-acquired OAuth access token (the component has no web UI). The two-caller scenario used two separately-obtained tokens from two independent authorization_code+PKCE sign-ins so the two requests were genuinely distinct calls, not a single token reused.

scenarios.scenario: A signed-in caller receives the greeting
